definitions.splits: development.csv uses each run's final 27-case development evaluation; holdout.csv uses only separately saved holdout_108.json. File names do not independently establish an untouched selection history.
definitions.change_sign: All user/grid changes are actual minus the stated baseline. Positive means increase; negative means reduction.
definitions.low_high_hours: Fixed bottom/top quartiles of the original profile baseline_load; not policy-dependent labels. TOU groups come from the original profile retail_price.
definitions.user_change: user_load - baseline_load, before wind/storage. This measures response relative to original demand, not a responsive tariff reference.
definitions.grid_change: actual grid - max(baseline_load-wind,0), using identical realized wind. Demand and storage contributions sum to the total, including zero-import clipping.
definitions.price_correlations: Pearson calculated within each scenario, then mean and positive fraction across valid cases. Neither statistic guarantees every scenario.
definitions.weighted_prices: Actual physical charge/discharge energy weights the realized wholesale price within each case; table reports the mean across valid cases. Positive price spread alone is not a profitability guarantee.
definitions.storage_margin: Grid-cost saving versus the same realized price/response path with zero storage minus throughput cost; no terminal SOC valuation.
definitions.settlement_precision: Storage margin uses the saved settlement totals. An independent float64 reconstruction is checked within a bound derived from float32 grid-cost rounding; its maximum absolute discrepancy is reported.
definitions.validation_scope: Frozen source hashes, effective input snapshots, complete/training counts, aggregate training returns, and all saved hourly policy learning rewards in the selected final development/holdout files are checked. Training hourly trajectories are not saved, so their individual hourly rewards cannot be audited retrospectively.
definitions.inference: These are sampled scenarios and saved trained models. Runs may change several permitted settings, so the table alone does not isolate a single causal factor or establish multi-seed robustness.
